source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #360 (branch fix/358-locals-overflow at head 3224217cc20d77fe65d4963a3c4a37e30de41d49 — the #358 change (checked arithmetic for locals count accumulation in the core parser) with the Codex-review follow-up (the reassignment table's v128 arm uses the total f64 count again), based on current main 6ec1ae13b5aa9d6886cdb0e89a87bccfee7bda20 (PR #352); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45650736249, 45650859975 and 45655383755 against the branch produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #360 (#358, checked arithmetic for locals count accumulation in the core parser), including the Codex-review follow-up (commit 3224217: the v128 arm of LocalsData::create_reassignment_table uses the total f64 count again — the checked rewrite had used the running count, placing a v128 group declared before an f64 group at offset 0, overlapping the f64 storage). The branch is based directly on current main 6ec1ae13b5aa9d6886cdb0e89a87bccfee7bda20 (PR #352), so no merge was needed. Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45649620006, 45649658859 and 45649743600 on main at 6ec1ae13b5aa9d6886cdb0e89a87bccfee7bda20; all three runs pass the gate, and the main control is byte-identical to the checked-in baseline on the twenty series of the baseline and core configurations; the twelve series of the three configurations that link telomere-component measure below their retained baselines, the shrinkage retained by PR #354's campaign). This PR's own delta against the main control: the four core configurations grow in both profiles (release stripped file +1,240 B (core), +1,224 B (core-nosimd), +1,224 B (core-jit), +1,224 B (core-aot) and stripped .text +1,104 B in each; release-size stripped file +3,360/+3,360/+3,360/+3,376 B and stripped .text +3,168/+3,168/+3,168/+3,184 B — the checked accumulation in LocalsData::try_from and create_reassignment_table in the telomere library), and the three configurations that link telomere-component grow slightly against the main control (release stripped file +2,072 B (component), +2,088 B (wasi), +2,056 B (wasi-threads) and stripped .text +1,952 B in each; release-size stripped file +1,888/+1,872/+2,288 B and stripped .text +1,680/+1,680/+2,080 B) while remaining far below their retained baselines. Following the established practice of re-baselining growth only, the sixteen core series are re-baselined to the branch measurements and the component-linking baselines are retained. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth remains the release component stripped file series at +11.42% (2,433,656 B to 2,711,648 B), unchanged because that series' baseline is retained. The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison.
